# Case 07 results: propensity vs uplift targeting on the Criteo uplift dataset

<!-- Generated by case-studies/07-criteo-uplift/src/run.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Reproduce (downloads ~300 MB on first run):

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
python case-studies/07-criteo-uplift/src/run.py
```

Seed `20261127`. Data: Criteo uplift dataset v2.1 (SHA-256 verified). 13,979,592 users, treatment randomized (85% treated). Intent-to-treat throughout: treatment means eligible to be targeted, and only 3.1% of all users were actually exposed. Train/test split 50/50. Each model is a ridge logistic regression on the 12 standardized features and their squares. The propensity model is fit on 2,000,000 treated training users, which is what a platform optimizing for outcomes learns. The control-arm model uses all 1,048,318 control training users.

## Randomized baseline (all users)

| Outcome | Control rate | Treated rate | ITT uplift (SE) | Relative lift |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| visit | 0.03820 | 0.04854 | +0.01034 (0.00015) | +27.1% |
| conversion | 0.00194 | 0.00309 | +0.00115 (0.00003) | +59.4% |
